thread_title: S. leuco. var. alba 'green and white' Bald. Co, AL (W.B)
breadcrumb: S. leuco. var. alba 'green and white' Bald. Co, AL (W.B)

posts.body_html:
This is one of those really white clones that I suspect is tough to entice to turn solid white. When I first saw the fall traps open, even though they weren't solid white, it has the tell-tale signs of being capable of producing very bright white traps. I've seen some HCW clones that produce red traps, so just because your plant isn't solid white on the first try, doesn't mean it can't change.



Here's S. leucophylla var. alba 'green and white' Baldwin Co, AL. Photo taken Oct. 6, 2013-these traps just opened at that time. Almost looks like a hurricane creek white to me:












And now, some more recent photos of the same exact traps, taken 10/25/13-notice they turned brighter white. I bet this thing will be even more impressive next year:







No doubt, this is definitely a nice clone, even if it's not at its fullest potential yet:
